stops.note: the Turkish name for the Stara Planina range that crosses Bulgaria
the geographer August Zeune extended the mountain name to the whole 'Balkan Peninsula' in 1808
the mountain-range name had reached English by 1794 for the Stara Planina alone; the peninsula-wide sense followed Zeune's German coinage
stops.meaning: of or relating to the Balkan Peninsula

current_meaning: relating to the Balkan Peninsula in southeastern Europe, or the region itself
